decisions.reason: Recently launched in a core product area, given its own page, and backed by sunk development and marketing effort, it is likely to be retained absent clear failure evidence.

Although only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it still fits the firm's garage-door portfolio and a large German manufacturer would usually give such a new launch more time before admitting defeat.

This operator variant is close to the firm's core offer and prior investment encourages persistence, though its lower visibility and overlap with other operators make it somewhat more droppable than the most prominently presented products.
The product supports the firm's industrial door business and compliance-oriented customer base, so management would be inclined to continue despite only modest public emphasis so far.
An insulated glazed industrial door aligns especially well with the firm's stated direction in flexible, customer-near technical solutions, making withdrawal soon after launch unlikely.
Because it was given its own page and sits squarely in the firm's established industrial sectional-door range, escalation of commitment makes continued support very likely.
